title: Wikipedia Economic Fear and Sentiment Index
description: Tracks Wikipedia pageviews for economic fear and sentiment terms - recession, inflation, bank run, financial crisis, stock market crash, and more. When the public starts researching 'recession' or 'bank run' on Wikipedia, fear is materializing into action. Academic research (Preis et al., 2013) demonstrated that Wikipedia pageview data for financial terms predicts S&P 500 movements. A composite fear score aggregates pageview trends across all tracked terms.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())

end_date = (now - timedelta(days=1)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
recent_start = (now - timedelta(days=8)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
prior_start = (now - timedelta(days=15)).strftime('%Y%m%d')
prior_end = (now - timedelta(days=8)).strftime('%Y%m%d')

headers = {'User-Agent': 'speakesQuery/1.0 (financial data aggregator)'}
base_url = 'https://wikimedia.org/api/rest_v1/metrics/pageviews/per-article/en.wikipedia/all-access/all-agents'

fear_terms = [
    {'article': 'Recession', 'category': 'macro'},
    {'article': 'Inflation', 'category': 'macro'},
    {'article': 'Stagflation', 'category': 'macro'},
    {'article': 'Deflation', 'category': 'macro'},
    {'article': 'Stock_market_crash', 'category': 'markets'},
    {'article': 'Bear_market', 'category': 'markets'},
    {'article': 'Bull_market', 'category': 'markets'},
    {'article': 'Financial_crisis', 'category': 'crisis'},
    {'article': 'Bank_run', 'category': 'crisis'},
    {'article': 'Great_Depression', 'category': 'crisis'},
    {'article': 'Unemployment', 'category': 'labor'},
    {'article': 'Layoff', 'category': 'labor'},
    {'article': 'Federal_Reserve', 'category': 'policy'},
    {'article': 'Interest_rate', 'category': 'policy'},
    {'article': 'Quantitative_easing', 'category': 'policy'},
    {'article': 'Tariff', 'category': 'trade'},
    {'article': 'Trade_war', 'category': 'trade'},
    {'article': 'United_States_debt_ceiling', 'category': 'fiscal'},
    {'article': 'Government_shutdown_in_the_United_States', 'category': 'fiscal'},
    {'article': 'Cryptocurrency', 'category': 'crypto'},
]

rows = []
total_pct_changes = []

for i in range(len(fear_terms)):
    term = fear_terms[i]
    article = term['article']
    category = term['category']

    url = base_url + '/' + article + '/daily/' + prior_start + '/' + end_date
    resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=30)
    if resp.status_code != 200:
        time.sleep(0.2)
        continue
    data = resp.json()
    items = data.get('items', [])
    if len(items) < 7:
        time.sleep(0.2)
        continue

    prior_views = []
    recent_views = []
    for j in range(len(items)):
        item = items[j]
        ts = str(item.get('timestamp', ''))
        day_str = ts[:8]
        views = int(item.get('views', 0))
        if day_str >= recent_start and day_str <= end_date:
            recent_views.append(views)
        elif day_str >= prior_start and day_str < prior_end:
            prior_views.append(views)

    if len(prior_views) == 0 or len(recent_views) == 0:
        time.sleep(0.2)
        continue

    prior_avg = sum(prior_views) / len(prior_views)
    recent_avg = sum(recent_views) / len(recent_views)
    pct_change = round(((recent_avg - prior_avg) / prior_avg) * 100, 2) if prior_avg > 0 else 0.0
    total_pct_changes.append(pct_change)

    if pct_change >= 100.0:
        alert = 'EXTREME_FEAR'
    elif pct_change >= 50.0:
        alert = 'HIGH_FEAR'
    elif pct_change >= 20.0:
        alert = 'ELEVATED'
    elif pct_change <= -20.0:
        alert = 'COMPLACENCY'
    else:
        alert = 'NORMAL'

    rows.append({
        'article': article,
        'category': category,
        'recent_7d_avg': round(recent_avg, 1),
        'prior_7d_avg': round(prior_avg, 1),
        'pct_change_wow': pct_change,
        'alert': alert,
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })
    time.sleep(0.2)

if len(total_pct_changes) > 0:
    composite_fear = round(sum(total_pct_changes) / len(total_pct_changes), 2)
else:
    composite_fear = 0.0

for i in range(len(rows)):
    rows[i]['composite_fear_index'] = composite_fear

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
if not df.empty:
    df = df.sort_values('pct_change_wow', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
